assumptions: Ideal straight pass at constant speed and depth; stationary receiver; smooth pressure-release surface (reflection -1); isovelocity c = 1500 m/s; no bottom path. Far-field form valid for r >> zs, zr.

atCpa.note: Fringes are narrowest (tightest spacing) at CPA, where range is least; this is the turning point of the "bat wing".

readDepth.needs: range from the CPA/Doppler fit and the known receiver depth; spacing alone gives only zs·zr/r

display: Waterfall: frequency x (0-500 Hz, 2.5 Hz bins), time y, newest at bottom; t=0 is the top row. Values in dB re direct path.
